category_title: Male preschool children who report physical peer aggression
scenario_title: Reporting physical aggression and property disputes during joint play
minimal_context: The student is participating in daily preschool activities and joint play with peers using materials like scissors, paintbrushes, and blocks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for joint play. You can build a tower with the blocks or use the scissors and paintbrushes at the art table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: She’s not finished yet with the paintbrush; she won’t hurry up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: See if you can find something else to do for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He won’t let me have the scissors.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to share with your friends.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (To peer) I’m telling the teacher! (To tutor) Matthew, he’s knocking down the tower! He tried to bited me!

task.content: Daily preschool activities and joint play

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Breaches of ''affect-backed'' norms involving physical harm or property loss
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Tattling on physical aggression, which boys reported much more frequently than girls, and using the threat of tattling as a strategic sanction against a peer's unwelcome behavior
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Highly egocentric, in that it tended to focus on achieving help or punishment for another child’s negative behavior toward the tattler
related_quotes: He won’t let me have the scissors
Matthew, he’s knocking down the tower

behavior_patterns.condition: When a peer engages in negative behavior toward the tattler
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Reporting of the various categories of norm violations, which was far more frequent than the reporting of positive or neutral behavior
related_quotes: James said I'm not Superman; James said I'm bad
She’s not ﬁnished yet [with the paintbrush]; she won’t hurry up
